title: TensorPlate Observability Config
description: Runtime configuration for `tensorplate-observability` (V01-E10). The service loads this file at startup, validates it before binding any local transport, and refuses to publish or write snapshots until validation succeeds. Defaults are local-only and never require hosted-platform connectivity. The observability service is independent from `tensorplate-agent` and `tensorplate-serving`: heartbeat freshness is evaluated against a monotonic clock and missing-heartbeat detection works without agent cooperation.

primary_source.description: Stable identifier for the source the in-process minimal heartbeat producer labels itself with. v0.1.0 default `serving_worker` lets the V01-E07 producer wire up without a schema bump.

listener.description: Bounded local event listener. Producers push HealthEvent / SupervisionEvent payloads; the listener normalises both into one internal health-input type.

transport.description: v0.1.0 supports `in_process`. `unix_socket` is reserved and returns a typed config error until the external socket listener lands.

queue_capacity.description: Bounded incoming-event queue capacity. The listener drops the oldest event when the queue is full and bumps a typed `dropped` counter.

heartbeat.description: Monotonic heartbeat policy. All timing uses monotonic time so wall-clock changes never affect freshness decisions.

safe_state.description: Local safe-state event sink. Bounded; a slow consumer never blocks heartbeat evaluation.

periodic_ms.description: Optional periodic emission interval. When set, the aggregator emits a safe-state event on every transition AND on every `periodic_ms` tick the current state is not `ready`.

snapshot.description: V01-E10-F06 minimal status snapshot. Includes the v0.1.0 required fields plus bookkeeping the V01-E11 CLI and V01-E15 validation harness need.

path.description: Absolute file path for `kind=file`. Writes use atomic-replace so readers never observe partial records.

ros2_health.description: V01-E10-F05 ROS 2 health topic stub. Optional; disabled by default so the baseline service runs in headless CI. When enabled the stub publishes diagnostic_msgs/msg/DiagnosticArray on `/tensorplate/health` with one DiagnosticStatus named `tensorplate/runtime`.

topic.description: ROS 2 topic name. Must start with `/`.

runtime.description: v0.1.0 ships the `mock` in-process publisher. `native` is reserved for the post-v0.1.0 `rclrs`-backed transport; selecting it today returns a typed config error.

diagnostics_retention.description: V01-E12 bounded structured-log retention and optional local file sink. Producers never block on this sink.

file_path.description: Absolute JSON-lines log file path. Omit for in-memory-only retention.

metrics.description: V01-E12 local-only metrics registry and export hook.

sink.description: Local metrics sink. `file.path` must be absolute.

path.description: Absolute JSON-lines metrics file path when kind=file.

control_loop.description: V01-E12 optional VLA control-loop jitter and frequency-stability metrics.
